capabilities: Review #card flashcards and cloze blocks in a side panel with Again/Hard/Good/Easy grading handled by Anki
Expand a card's context through breadcrumbs and browse a history of answered cards
Filter cards by subject, recency and a daily goal with progress from Anki's review log
Sync phone answers to Anki on the computer through an Upstash Redis relay with per-answer status
Remove card markers from a line while keeping the text, with undo
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the free Upstash plan is enough for sync; no telemetry and only card IDs and ratings are uploaded, never card content; without sync the phone can read cards but not answer them.
intentEvidence: The Flashcards plugin, which syncs cards to Anki and records each block's Anki note ID
problem: The Flashcards plugin syncs cards to Anki but offers no in-vault review interface, and progress made on a phone doesn't reach Anki on the computer.
